# What's in the workspace

English | [日本語](workspace-image.ja.md)

<!-- Generated by scripts/workspace_image.py. Do not edit: change scripts/workspace-image/tools.tsv and run it. -->

The tools a workspace comes with, the version the image fixes, and each tool's licence.

- **Version**: "Selectable" means each member picks the version under ⚙ Settings → Toolchains
  ([Choose your toolchains](../user/workspace/toolchains.md)); the image default is used until they do.
  Most agent CLIs can also be updated to their latest version at start, from the same tab
- Some tools, such as the agent CLIs, rtk, the Google Cloud CLI and the database servers, are downloaded into your home on
  first start or first use, at the version shown here
- A deployment that runs without a browser has no Chromium ([deployment targets](deploy-targets.md))
- The agent CLIs are third-party software, each under its vendor's licence or terms. Each member signs in with their own
  account
- You can install more tools into `~/.local` yourself

## Agent Fleet commands

| Tool | What it is for | Version | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| [workspace-agent](https://github.com/k-k1/agent-fleet) | Runs your sessions and connects the workspace to the Console | Same as Agent Fleet | [Apache-2.0](https://github.com/k-k1/agent-fleet/blob/main/LICENSE) |
| [af-arch-repair](cli/af-arch-repair.md) | Reinstall your own pip, uv and npm installs after the CPU architecture changed | Same as Agent Fleet | [Apache-2.0](https://github.com/k-k1/agent-fleet/blob/main/LICENSE) |
| [af-aws-exec](cli/af-aws-exec.md) | Run one command with the permissions of an AWS profile | Same as Agent Fleet | [Apache-2.0](https://github.com/k-k1/agent-fleet/blob/main/LICENSE) |
| [af-clean](cli/af-clean.md) | List and remove regenerable build output and caches | Same as Agent Fleet | [Apache-2.0](https://github.com/k-k1/agent-fleet/blob/main/LICENSE) |
| [af-db](cli/af-db.md) | Run PostgreSQL and MySQL in the workspace and print connection URLs | Same as Agent Fleet | [Apache-2.0](https://github.com/k-k1/agent-fleet/blob/main/LICENSE) |
| [af-gcloud-exec](cli/af-gcloud-exec.md) | Run one command with a token of a Google Cloud profile | Same as Agent Fleet | [Apache-2.0](https://github.com/k-k1/agent-fleet/blob/main/LICENSE) |
| [af-memory](cli/af-memory.md) | List, import, write back and lint Agent Fleet memory from a terminal | Same as Agent Fleet | [Apache-2.0](https://github.com/k-k1/agent-fleet/blob/main/LICENSE) |
| [af-scratch](cli/af-scratch.md) | Move build output onto the working disk, on deployments that have one | Same as Agent Fleet | [Apache-2.0](https://github.com/k-k1/agent-fleet/blob/main/LICENSE) |
| [af-watch-hook](cli/af-watch-hook.md) | Add a webhook to a private repository so watches are poked | Same as Agent Fleet | [Apache-2.0](https://github.com/k-k1/agent-fleet/blob/main/LICENSE) |
